purpose: Review-only mapping of the household policy guide to vendor-neutral home capabilities and Decionis policy shape.

rules.name: Allow a direct parent disarm request only on a trusted identity claim
rules.rationale: Mirrors the guide's parent-role override, but remains disabled until an authenticated identity provider supplies this claim independently of Bedrock/MCP arguments.

rules.name: Require parent approval when a child requests a home security disarm
rules.rationale: A child's request to disarm home security requires a parent to complete Decionis-managed Presence verification. No execution grant exists before Decionis reauthorizes the unchanged intent.

rules.name: Allow expected recognized courier at the side gate during the authorized window
rules.rationale: Identity and delivery intent are insufficient on their own; this bounded unlock also requires a local-time value inside the configured household window.

rules.name: Block an otherwise recognized courier outside the authorized window
rules.rationale: Block the side-gate unlock after 15:00 local household time, even when the courier is expected and recognized. The policy owner must confirm the tenant's stable reason-code mapping before publication.

rules.name: Block an otherwise recognized courier before the authorized window
rules.rationale: Block the side-gate unlock before 14:00 local household time, even when the courier is expected and recognized.

metadata.author: HomeBound
metadata.source_policy_guide: Child requests to disable security require parental Presence sign-off; parent approval is role-bound; courier access is limited by target, exact action, context, and time.
unresolved_before_submission: Confirm Decionis field-path resolution and GTE/LTE handling for AgentSafe action parameters against a dry-run in this tenant.
Confirm that the policy's 14:00–15:00 local-time window matches the household's intended schedule and timezone.
Bind local_time, courier identity, and expected-delivery status to trusted sources; the demo fixture alone is not proof.
Bind the APPROVER role to the enrolled parent principal in Decionis/Presence; do not assume an email address is a Presence principal ID.
Confirm that the Decionis policy editor accepts the HIGH_CONFIDENCE and ACTIVE_LIVENESS verification requirements.
Confirm a stable Decionis denial reason code for OUTSIDE_AUTHORIZED_DELIVERY_WINDOW.
The direct parent-role override is present but disabled until HomeBound receives an authenticated parent identity claim; the Presence-approved resume is the current parent path.
